pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Polygonal dark brown regions with star-like, jagged edges. The individual units exhibit irregular geometry with multiple sharp points extending into the negative space, particularly on the mid-flank and shoulder regions.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous network of light cream-colored pathways separating the patches. The paths maintain a narrow and relatively consistent pixel thickness, forming a complex topological graph with frequent three-way junction nodes.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane presents a high-frequency, low-amplitude serrated silhouette along the neck and upper shoulder. Individual tufts are visible as short, vertical protrusions against the background.
